summary: Fukuyama City publishes a real 2026 citywide parcel-number polygon Shapefile. A bounded inspection verified 789640 polygons and stable-looking native LINKKEY identities, but the download has no declared CRS and the city limits the map to fixed-asset assessment reference use. Runtime admission remains held pending independent CRS/adapter qualification.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Japanese first-party discovery queries are recorded in city-3586-fukuyama.json. Both led to the city open-data catalog and official explanatory/procedure pages.
requestOutcomes: Catalog GET succeeded; direct ZIP download succeeded; the resource landing route returned HTML; local OGR inspection verified polygon geometry, fields, count, extent, and a 10-feature bounded spatial response. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe fields, or owner/address lookups were used.
scopeLimits: The dataset is described by Fukuyama as an assembled 地番図 for fixed-asset valuation, not a surveyed/legal boundary or rights source.
No exact-point hit/miss was used as an absence claim and the WUP point was not shifted.
Citywide completeness and exact municipal boundary coverage were not independently reconstructed.
The download has no .prj and OGR reports unknown SRS; no GeoJSON sample was retained because a WGS84 conversion would be speculative.
National Legal Affairs Bureau evidence identifies a local registry office but does not establish an open registry API.
nativeIdentityPolicy: If later retained, use LINKKEY as the sole GeoJSON id because it is a source-provided composite identity (AZACD/TXTCD provenance is documented in metadata, not feature properties). Do not use OBJEXOID as a synthetic substitute without further stability evidence.

nativeFieldMapping.LINKKEY: source composite identity observed in the polygon layer, e.g. AZACD/TXTCD
nativeFieldMapping.AZACD: source area/aza code; not retained in sample properties
nativeFieldMapping.TXTCD: source parcel-number text; not retained in sample properties
nativeFieldMapping.OBJEXOID: source integer object field; not selected as canonical identity

crs: unverified; no .prj or SRS metadata in the public ZIP
geometryQuality: Polygon geometry verified in the native Shapefile; legal/survey accuracy expressly disclaimed by the city; WGS84 usability unverified
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review and adapter qualification still required
uncertainty: A genuine local public parcel geometry source exists, but coordinate reference, legal semantics, exact coverage, and safe runtime transformation remain unresolved. This packet must not be treated as source integration/admission.
